<p style="text-align: center;"><span data-contrast="auto">Age Limit:</span><span data-contrast="auto"> Participants must be 21 years or older to enter the contest. Valid ID required.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>

<p style="text-align: center;"><b><span data-contrast="auto">Appropriateness:</span></b> <span data-contrast="auto">All costumes must be suitable for public viewing.
